name: youtube_transcript
description: Extract the transcript/subtitles from a YouTube video. Useful for learning from video content without watching.

video_url.description: YouTube video URL or video ID

manual.overview: Use youtube_transcript to extract subtitles/captions from YouTube videos. This lets you learn from video content without watching. Great for tutorials, lectures, and educational content.
tips: You can pass either the full URL or just the video ID.
Not all videos have captions — auto-generated ones may have errors.
For educational videos, combine with note_memory to save key points.
edge_cases: Private or age-restricted videos cannot be accessed.
Some videos have no captions at all.
Auto-generated captions may have inaccuracies, especially for technical terms.

_note: Requires youtube-transcript-api package. Install with: pip install youtube-transcript-api

executor.command: python -c "from youtube_transcript_api import YouTubeTranscriptApi; import sys, json; vid='{{args.video_url}}'.split('v=')[-1].split('&')[0]; t=YouTubeTranscriptApi.get_transcript(vid, languages=['{{args.language}}']); print(' '.join(e['text'] for e in t))"
